biography.value:
Tempest dragons are storms with wings. Wherever they fly, thunderheads gather, and lightning follows them into the hearts of cities.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .90Rxs5ALZOma98rN]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .qXu9W0OHRdPQy9Pm]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .6sIoYYxnyU7GdA3I]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=1ATpknacWvguYdud]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=1ATpknacWvguYdud]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=1ATpknacWvguYdud]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=Z8ajo750wCAMjMyT]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a storm-bolt in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=3wFmIthLlUvX0r12]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=3wFmIthLlUvX0r12]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=3wFmIthLlUvX0r12]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Half the damage is lightning and half is thunder.
At the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Lightning strikes a point within 120 feet: each creature within 5 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failure.
  • Thunder booms; each creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be &Reference[deafened] until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • Wind gusts; each flying creature other than the dragon must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 20 feet.
